headword: {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}

definitions.explanation: the date by which a borrowed item must be returned

examples.japanese: {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}は{来週|らいしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}です。
examples.english: The return deadline is next Friday.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}の{本|ほん}の{返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}が{過|す}ぎてしまった。
examples.english: The return deadline for the library book has passed.

examples.japanese: {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}を{守|まも}らないと{延滞料|えんたいりょう}がかかるので{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful, as late fees will be charged if you don't meet the return deadline.

notes:
Composed of {返却|へんきゃく} (return, giving back) + {期限|きげん} (deadline, time limit). Most commonly encountered in libraries, rental services, and equipment lending contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}を{守|まも}る: to meet the return deadline
- {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}が{過|す}ぎる: for the return deadline to pass
- {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}を{延長|えんちょう}する: to extend the return deadline
- {返却期限|へんきゃくきげん}{日|び}: return due date

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {締|し}め{切|き}り: deadline — general term for any deadline
- {期限|きげん}: deadline, time limit — the general concept
- {返却日|へんきゃくび}: return date — the specific date of return
- {貸出期間|かしだしきかん}: lending period — the duration for which something can be borrowed
